exposure: enhanced recovery after Caesarean section (ERAC) programme
outcome: Obstetric Quality of Recovery-10 score (postpartum recovery)
cohort: 52 patients aged 18 years or older undergoing elective Caesarean section in a Johannesburg public hospital.
finding: Implementation of an enhanced recovery after Caesarean section (ERAC) programme significantly improved maternal postpartum recovery (Obstetric Quality of Recovery-10 score) and reduced opioid consumption in patients undergoing elective Caesarean section.
